name: Wildcraft: Fruits and Nuts
//: Fruits, nuts, berries and the bushes and trees they grow on. The base game's values for the same families are copied, since these are the same things from more species: a fruit 16, seeds 4, a fruiting bush 32, a cutting 16, a sapling 32. Only used when nothing else values the item; the '//' lines say why each number was chosen.

defaultValues.//nut-*: a nut: like a legume (8), half a fruit
defaultValues.//berry-*: a berry: between a nut (8) and a fruit (16)
defaultValues.//*bush-*: every other bush family (berry, prickly, shrub...): like a fruiting bush (32)
defaultValues.//fruittree-*: like the game's fruit tree parts (16)
defaultValues.//vine-*: like the game's wild vines (1), doubled for bearing fruit
